# Diabetes Prediction Project

## Overview

This project focuses on diabetes prediction using Python. The notebook includes data preprocessing, exploratory data analysis, feature scaling, and machine learning model building to predict whether a patient has diabetes.

## Dataset

* Structured dataset in CSV format
* Contains medical and health-related attributes
* Used for classification and predictive modeling
* Preprocessing steps applied to handle missing values, scaling, and feature selection

## Models

* Logistic Regression
* Decision Tree Classifier
* Random Forest Classifier
* Support Vector Machine (SVM)

## Tools & Libraries

* Python
* NumPy
* Pandas
* Scikit-learn
* Matplotlib
* Seaborn

## File

* `Diabetes Prediction.ipynb` – main notebook containing analysis and model training
